latest.title: Tile sets consisting of two types of concave polygons derived from periodic tilings corresponding to non-periodic tilings with hat and turtle tiles
latest.abstract: Using a convex pentagonal monotile belonging to the Type 5 family, we investigate the relationships among the hat tile, turtle tile, and Tile$(1, 1)$. By applying Sugimoto's Perspective and Amfirifma's Perspective, we obtain four types of concave polygons, AH-tile, BH-tile, AT-tile, and BT-tile, each having Heesch number 1 under the conditions considered. We show that these polygons correspond to clusters used to generate the non-periodic tilings $\mathscr{T}_h$ and $\mathscr{T}_s$. We further discuss the possibility that tile sets consisting of pairs selected from these polygons may correspond to $\textit{ASPmr}\{\text{A-tile}, \text{B-tile}\}$.
latest.workSummary: 从周期五边形铺砌构造四类凹多边形，并分析它们与 hat、turtle 非周期铺砌簇的对应。
latest.breakthrough: 提供连接几类铺砌系统的具体构造。
latest.limitations: 部分成对瓦片系统的关系仅为可能性讨论，不能当作已证明的非周期性。 当前为摘要级分析，技术细节与结论须回查原文。
